notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two base-cabinet drawers and the two independently manipulated doors of the upper cabinet. The range-hood and under-cabinet lights remain illuminated without a visible state change and are not counted.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, and finally opens and closes a utensil drawer on the opposite side of the stove.
